items: 【Ideal Fit with Free Size Exchange】Measure your waist at the navel to choose the right size. S: 28.7-35.8", M: 32.3-39.8", L: 35.8-43.7", XL: 39.4-47.6", XXL: 43.3-52.4". Enjoy free size exchange and a 1-year product care for added confidence.

【8X Effective Back Support】Rakiie back brace for men and women features an ergonomic support system (2 bionic lumbar stays + 4 memory aluminum supports + 2 elastic springs) that provides comprehensive 8X support to the back, delivering solid lower back support, and limiting unnecessary back movement. For optimal comfort, we recommend wearing the brace over clothing.

【Enhanced 3D Core-Stabilizing Pad】This back brace features a removable 3D support pad that precisely contours to the natural curve of your lumbar spine. It delivers gentle cushioning and targeted compression to effectively alleviate lower back pressure and muscle fatigue.

【Breathable & Comfortable Design】 This lumbar support belt utilizes lightweight 3D knitted mesh material. The breathable fabric promotes continuous airflow against the skin, effectively dissipating heat to keep you cool, dry, and comfortable throughout daily activities.

【Adjustable Compression】This lower back brace is engineered with a pulley system for effortless adjustment and tiered pressure zones that distribute support evenly for optimal comfort. You can fine-tune the compression using the elastic straps. The durable fasteners are tested to withstand over 3,200 uses for long-lasting performance.
【Daily Movement Support】Provides comfortable, stabilizing assistance for common activities like desk work, long drives, gaming sessions, moving furniture, gardening, and repetitive bending.

【Trusted Brand and Reliable Choice】Rakiie is dedicated to offering reliable, safe, and user-friendly products to enhance your active lifestyle. Hundreds of thousands trust Rakiie and join us to embrace a more energetic lifestyle. Every back brace includes a 1-year warranty, and our dedicated support team is available around the clock to assist you whenever needed.
